audit_kind: bounded read-only static reproducibility and delivery audit
result: No source/dependency blocker found; final copy, full standalone library rebuild and exhaustive axiom gate remain the coordinator responsibility.

dependency_checks.evidence: Development HEAD and standalone Mathlib HEAD equal the pinned public fork commit; both have no tracked Mathlib edits or untracked Mathlib sources. The only tracked development change is lakefile.lean registering the new library/default target.

module_checks.glob_evidence: Lake v4.34.0-rc2 Glob.ofString? maps the .+ suffix to all submodules; LeanLibConfig states submodule globs build every source file recursively. globs=[AlternatingAnalytic,AlternatingAnalytic.+], defaultTargets=[AlternatingAnalytic] therefore covers the umbrella and every owned module, even those not yet imported by it.
module_checks.zero_arity: No special build target is needed: universally quantified natural arities include zero unless the theorem states a positivity hypothesis. No material zero-arity packaging issue found.

shortcut_scan.qualification: Text scan is not an axiom-closure proof. Final coordinator kernel/axiom enumeration remains required.

cache_reuse.details: Eight transitive package directories are absolute symlinks to clean pinned development dependencies. Standalone Mathlib sources are a separate clean checkout, while Mathlib/Cache oleans and build tools reuse development caches.
cache_reuse.evidence: Standalone mathlib/.lake/build/lib/lean exposes only Mathlib, Cache, mk_all and lint-style artifacts; it does not expose an AlternatingAnalytic directory.
cache_reuse.required_claim: The standalone project rebuilds the copied formalization using pinned, cached dependencies. This audit did not perform a cold dependency clone/build.
cache_reuse.packaging_action: Exclude the complete .lake directory and all absolute cache symlinks from the deliverable; retain lake-manifest.json.

source_provenance.change_assessment: Editorial only: the three text diff hunks clarify Theorem A provenance and its non-use in the main proof, name the existing Lean declaration, and reword its heading. Theorem A mathematical statement and all other mathematical passages are unchanged.
